content.title: Novo cuts obesity drug prices, Alphabet rises, Aramark tumbles
content.description:
Here are some of the stocks on the move Monday, Nov. 17.

Novo Nordisk (NVO) announced it will cut the prices for consumers who pay cash for its popular weight-loss drug Wegovy and diabetes drug Ozempic.

Shares of Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) are rising after Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) announced it had taken a stake in the tech giant.

Aramark Holdings (ARMK) shares are tumbling after reporting fiscal fourth quarter results that fell short of estimates.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
